provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

nameChecks.ja: 奪われ泣き叫ぶヒンドリー

gameLocalization.note: Exact game IDs distinguish shared Japanese names. Guide spelling and ellipsis variants are resolved against these paired localization records.

lead.text: Win early Clashes to build SP and prevent hit-triggered healing and Speed buffs. The mark aimed at Heathcliff applies even when you win, so prepare to redirect next turn's attacks. A turn-long 40% HP floor prevents finishing immediately; save major skills for the second half.

listLead.text: Build SP in opening Clashes and prevent hit-triggered healing and Speed buffs. The mark applies even if you win, so prepare next turn's defense too. Save damage for after the HP floor.

statNote.text: The Focused Encounter in 6-32. Enemy Level 43, 2073 HP, Defense Level 42. All physical damage is neutral; Wrath and Envy are effective. Heathcliff is mandatory. This excludes normal Hindley and Wild Hunt versions' values.

skillNote.text: 9 skills. Base ranges exclude Speed, HP conditions, and Offense Level Up. “Bloody Bastard!” has 2 Coins; conditional reuse is not listed as a permanent third Coin. “Give It Back...!!” is unclashable.

priorities.0.text: Aim for Level 43 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Build SP through early winning Clashes, with Wrath/Envy damage and SP recovery.

priorities.1.text: The turn after “I'll Get You...!”'s [On Use] effect, check attacks aimed at the marked Sinner and the Speed gap. Use faster allies to redirect attacks where possible.

priorities.2.text: Reaching 40% HP (829) activates the floor for that turn. Save major skills for buffed second-half Clashes and the 25% HP Stagger Threshold.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: A mark or Paralyze applies despite winning the Clash

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: “I'll Get You...!” applies next turn's mark, Fragile, Paralyze, and Bind [On Use]. Preventing hits does not remove them. Prepare a fast redirector and Defense Skills for the following attacks.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: A Place for Me applies a 40% HP floor for that turn. Save strong skills for dangerous attacks from next turn rather than spending all damage immediately.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: He heals and defeats allies with heavy Bleed

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: The enemy heals on hits and kills. Stop “This Is My Home!”, which prioritizes low HP, and “You Little...”, which prioritizes marked targets. Prevent repeated attacks on heavily Bleeding Sinners.

units.0.notes.0.text: Normally has 6 actions including Defense Skills. At 65% HP or less, inserts unclashable “Give It Back...!!” into the pattern.

units.0.notes.1.text: After the 40% HP (829) floor, changes to second-half actions.

units.0.notes.2.text: Once the 65% and 40% HP buff conditions are met, healing does not remove them.

phases.0.title.text: Build SP through Clashes you can win

phases.0.steps.0.text: Assign winning skills against attacks such as “I'll Remove You” and build SP-recovery resources. Preventing hits also limits healing and Offense Level Up.

phases.0.steps.1.text: “Bloody Bastard!” scales with Speed difference; “This Is My Home!” with target HP percentage. If a low-HP Sinner is targeted, redirect eligible attacks with faster allies.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Offset Evade and focus Wrath/Envy damage during the 75% HP Stagger. After the first Stagger ends, enemy Clash wins can also lead to additional Wrath damage.

phases.1.title.text: Prepare for unclashable attacks and the turn after marking

phases.1.steps.0.text: At 65% or less, an action pattern including “Give It Back...!!” is inserted regardless of the preceding sequence. It is unclashable; use the target's defense and remaining HP to limit damage.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Winning against “I'll Get You...!” does not remove next turn's mark, Fragile, Paralyze, or Bind. Recheck attack targets and Speed gaps next turn.

phases.1.steps.2.text: At 65% HP or less, Clash wins grant buffs; at 40% or less, skill use grants them. Once met, these conditions persist after healing, so avoid prolonging the fight.

phases.2.title.text: Save damage for after the floor and reach 25% HP Stagger

phases.2.steps.0.text: On the turn the 829 HP floor is reached, extra major attacks cannot finish him. Check remaining Clashes and defense, saving strong skills for next turn.

phases.2.steps.1.text: The second half adds “This is My Place!” and “You Little...”. Check Speed gaps and marks, then assign skills that win against the buffed predictions.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Reach the 25% HP Stagger and finish him without allowing hit-triggered healing. Killing a wounded Sinner restores 200 HP and grants next-turn buffs, so keep checking remaining HP through the end.

skills.0.effects.0.text: Heal overall and Part HP by 10% of damage dealt by this Attack Skill.

skills.0.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up.

skills.0.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up.

skills.0.response.text: Heals 10% of damage dealt and gains Offense Level on hit. Use it as an easier early Clash to limit healing and buffs.

skills.1.effects.0.text: If faster than the target, gain +2 Clash Power.

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.1.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.1.effects.3.text: [On Hit] If at least 3 Speed faster than the target, reuse this Coin once at most.

skills.1.response.text: Gains +2 Clash Power when faster, and reuses the second Coin once at a Speed advantage of at least 3. Check Speed and Bleed rather than assigning an answer only to the unbuffed maximum of 11.

skills.2.effects.0.text: Prioritize the target with the lowest current HP.

skills.2.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target is below 70% of Max HP, gain +2 Clash Power.

skills.2.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn.

skills.2.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.2.effects.5.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.2.effects.6.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] If the target has at least 20 Bleed, deal +100% damage.

skills.2.effects.7.text: [On Kill] Reuse this skill once at most.

skills.2.response.text: Prioritizes lowest current HP and gains +2 Clash Power [On Use] against targets below 70% HP. Its fourth Coin deals +100% damage at 20 or more Bleed; keep it away from wounded Sinners.

skills.3.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target is the slowest enemy, gain +3 Base Power.

skills.3.effects.2.text: [On Use] Inflict Marked Prey, 2 Fragile, 3 Paralyze, and 5 Bind next turn.

skills.3.effects.3.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up.

skills.3.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up.

skills.3.response.text: Prioritizes Heathcliff. Marked Prey and next-turn 2 Fragile, 3 Paralyze, and 5 Bind are [On Use] effects and remain after winning. Prepare next turn's defense too.

skills.4.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[Heads Hit] Gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn.

skills.4.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[Heads Hit] Gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn.

skills.4.effects.3.text: Ⅲ[Heads Hit] Gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn.

skills.4.effects.4.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, deal +30% damage.

skills.4.effects.5.text: [On Hit] If the target has at least 5 Bleed, heal HP equal to 50% of damage dealt.

skills.4.response.text: Unclashable. An Attack Skill cannot prevent the unopposed hit, so check the target's Defense Skill, resistances, and HP. Hits against at least 5 Bleed also allow healing.

skills.5.effects.1.text: If the target is at least 3 Speed slower, reuse this skill once at most.

skills.5.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Heal overall and Part HP by 50% of damage dealt.

skills.5.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal overall and Part HP by 50% of damage dealt.

skills.5.response.text: Prioritizes Marked Prey, reusing the skill once if the target is at least 3 Speed slower. Each hit heals 50% of damage dealt, so prevent damage through Clashes or defense.

skills.6.effects.0.text: At Turn End, if Shield remains, gain 4 Protection next turn.

skills.6.response.text: A Shield remaining at Turn End grants 4 Protection next turn. Offset or prepare enough damage to break it after activation and avoid stalling your damage.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [On Evade] Inflict 1 Bind next turn, up to 2.

skills.7.response.text: Successful Evades inflict up to 2 Bind next turn. Offset with a Defense Skill to stop slowed allies from also triggering Speed-based bonuses.

skills.8.effects.0.text: If faster than the target, gain +1 Coin Power.

skills.8.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, deal +30% damage.

skills.8.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, deal +30% damage.

skills.8.effects.3.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, deal +30% damage.

skills.8.effects.4.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, deal +30% damage.

skills.8.effects.5.text: [On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, heal HP equal to 70% of damage dealt.

skills.8.response.text: Gains +1 Coin Power when faster, reaching a maximum of 23. At 10 or more Bleed, every Coin's extra damage and the final healing become dangerous. Save a strong late-fight Clash for this.

passives.0.response.text: Do not assume Panic alone will disable him for long.

passives.1.condition.text: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type

passives.1.effect.text: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.1.response.text: Do not rely on changing Panic Type.

passives.2.effect.text: For 1 turn, HP cannot fall below 40%, and the action pattern changes.

passives.2.response.text: Do not spend all major skills on the turn this threshold is reached.

passives.3.condition.text: Has reached 65% HP or less / 40% HP or less at least once

passives.3.effect.text: At 65% or less, gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 HP Healing Boost on Clash Win. At 40% or less, gain them [On Use]. Once met, the conditions remain active after healing.

passives.3.response.text: Healing does not remove these buffs. Win Clashes and shorten the second half.

passives.4.condition.text: Clash Win after the first Stagger ends

passives.4.effect.text: Attack Skill hits deal additional Wrath damage equal to 10% of damage dealt.

passives.4.response.text: After Stagger, avoid losing Clashes and allowing repeated hits.

passives.5.effect.text: Heal 200 overall and Part HP. Gain 1 Haste, 3 Defense Level Up, and 2 Offense Level Up next turn.

passives.5.response.text: Prevent focused attacks on low-HP Sinners.

passives.6.response.text: Check next turn's Speed and targets before choosing a redirector.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Whenever damaged, take additional Slash damage equal to 10% of damage taken. Expires next turn. If no damage is taken, it can instead apply 1 Inferiority Complex at the end of the attack and expire.

mechanics.0.response.text: Prevent repeated unopposed hits on marked allies, and check actual targeting lines.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Whenever damaged, take additional damage equal to 20% of damage taken × the value, up to 5 stacks.

mechanics.1.response.text: Avoid hits on affected Sinners and prevent attacks from concentrating on the same target.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Heathcliff is mandatory and normally gains SP-draining Bereavement. His Wild Hunt Identity changes it to Unending Bereavement.

mechanics.2.response.text: Prepare his training and SP maintenance. After Speed debuffs and Paralyze, other Sinners should help redirect next turn's attacks.

warnings.0.text: Assigning an Attack Skill to an unclashable attack does not stop the enemy's unopposed hit.

warnings.1.text: Marks, Paralyze, and Bind apply [On Use]. Winning the Clash alone does not make next turn safe.

warnings.2.text: The 40% HP floor and 25% HP Stagger are separate conditions.

warnings.3.text: Do not apply 6-34's defeat condition or emotion mechanics to this fight.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Level 43 and Uptie III or higher on your main units, including Heathcliff.

preparation.1.text: Prepare Wrath/Envy damage, SP recovery, and powerful Clashes. Sloth and Pride damage are halved.

preparation.2.text: Prepare fast redirectors and Defense Skills for unclashable attacks.

roles.0.reason.text: Build SP while limiting hit-triggered healing and Offense Level Up.

roles.1.reason.text: Redirect eligible attacks away from allies carrying the mark, Paralyze, and Bind.

roles.2.reason.text: Create Stagger openings and shorten the fight after the HP floor.
